response.rationale: R3 is the champion due to the presence of multiple classic symptoms of Kawasaki disease, including bilateral nonpurulent conjunctivitis, erythematous throat, palmar erythema, strawberry tongue, and an erythema multiforme–type rash. R1 is the runner-up, but the negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR and blood cultures make MIS-C less likely.

rejected.why: negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR and blood cultures
absence of joint symptoms and other findings
negative blood cultures and lack of specific symptoms
